name: fetch_lit
statement:
theorem fetch_lit (prog : Program) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 2 ^ prog.logSize := by decide) :
    prog.fetch (gpow j) = some (prog.code ⟨j, hj⟩)
proof:
:=
  prog.fetch_gpow ⟨j, hj⟩

name: fetch_one
statement: theorem fetch_one (prog : Program) : prog.fetch 1 = some (prog.code ⟨0, Nat.two_pow_pos _⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using prog.fetch_gpow ⟨0, Nat.two_pow_pos _⟩

name: read_lit
statement:
theorem read_lit {κ : ℕ} (L : MemImage κ) (j : ℕ) (hκ : κ < 64 := by decide)
    (hj : j < 2 ^ κ := by decide) : L.read (gpow j) = some (L ⟨j, hj⟩)
proof:
:=
  MemImage.read_gpow hκ L ⟨j, hj⟩

name: read_one
statement:
theorem read_one {κ : ℕ} (L : MemImage κ) (hκ : κ < 64 := by decide) :
    L.read 1 = some (L ⟨0, Nat.two_pow_pos _⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using MemImage.read_gpow hκ L ⟨0, Nat.two_pow_pos _⟩

name: read_g
statement:
theorem read_g {κ : ℕ} (L : MemImage κ) (hκ : κ < 64 := by decide)
    (h1 : 1 < 2 ^ κ := by decide) : L.read g = some (L ⟨1, h1⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using MemImage.read_gpow hκ L ⟨1, h1⟩

name: read_sixteen
statement: theorem read_sixteen (L : MemImage 4) : L.read (gpow 16) = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [MemImage.read, gLog?_gpow_eq_none (by decide) (by decide), Option.map_none]

name: g_mul_gpow
statement: theorem g_mul_gpow (i : ℕ) : g * gpow i = gpow (i + 1)
proof: := (gpow_succ i).symm

name: mul_step0
statement: theorem mul_step0 : step mulProg mulImage ⟨1, 1⟩ = some ⟨gpow 1, 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_of_fetch_eq_some (r := ⟨1, 1⟩) (fetch_one mulProg)]
  show execute mulImage ⟨1, 1⟩ (.setConstant (gpow 2) mulX) = _
  simp only [execute, one_mul, read_lit mulImage 2]
  decide +kernel

name: mul_step1
statement: theorem mul_step1 : step mulProg mulImage ⟨gpow 1, 1⟩ = some ⟨gpow 2, 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_of_fetch_eq_some (r := ⟨gpow 1, 1⟩) (fetch_lit mulProg 1)]
  show execute mulImage ⟨gpow 1, 1⟩ (.setConstant (gpow 3) mulY) = _
  simp only [execute, one_mul, read_lit mulImage 3]
  decide +kernel

name: mul_step2
statement: theorem mul_step2 : step mulProg mulImage ⟨gpow 2, 1⟩ = some ⟨gpow 3, 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_of_fetch_eq_some (r := ⟨gpow 2, 1⟩) (fetch_lit mulProg 2)]
  show execute mulImage ⟨gpow 2, 1⟩ (.mulNative (gpow 2) (gpow 3) (gpow 4)) = _
  simp only [execute, one_mul, read_lit mulImage 2, read_lit mulImage 3, read_lit mulImage 4]
  decide +kernel

name: mul_run
statement: theorem mul_run : run mulProg mulImage 3 Regs.initial = some (Regs.final mulProg)
proof:
:= by
  show run mulProg mulImage 3 ⟨1, 1⟩ = some ⟨gpow 3, 1⟩
  simp (disch := decide +kernel) only [run_succ_of_ne, mul_step0, mul_step1, mul_step2,
    Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, run_zero]

name: mulImage_boundary
statement:
theorem mulImage_boundary {prog : Program} (steps : ℕ) :
    HasPublicBoundary mulInput (⟨minLogMem, mulImage, steps⟩ : Trace prog)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨le_rfl, (by decide : minLogMem ≤ maxLogMem), ?_, ?_⟩
  · show mulImage.read (gpow 0) = some (mulImage ⟨0, by decide⟩)
    exact read_lit mulImage 0
  · show mulImage.read (gpow 1) = some (mulImage ⟨1, by decide⟩)
    exact read_lit mulImage 1

name: ctl_pointer
statement: theorem ctl_pointer : (ctlImage ⟨5, by decide⟩).limb 0 = gpow 7
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: ofK_eq_ofLimbs
statement: theorem ofK_eq_ofLimbs (a : K) : ofK a = E.ofLimbs a 0 0
proof: := E.ext fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> simp

name: halt_step
statement: theorem halt_step : step haltProg ctlImage Regs.initial = some ⟨g, g⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_of_fetch_eq_some (r := Regs.initial) (fetch_one _)]
  show execute ctlImage ⟨1, 1⟩ (.jump (gpow 2) (gpow 14) (gpow 14)) = _
  simp only [execute, one_mul, read_lit ctlImage 2, read_lit ctlImage 14]
  decide +kernel

name: blake_reads
statement:
theorem blake_reads (out1 : E) :
    execute (blakeImage out1) ⟨1, 1⟩ blakeIns =
      (do
        guard (CompressCells ![rustM0, rustM1, rustM2, rustM3] rustCv0 rustCv1 rustOut0 out1
          rustMd)
        pure (Regs.next ⟨1, 1⟩))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [blakeIns, execute, one_mul, mul_one, Matrix.cons_val, g_mul_gpow, Nat.reduceAdd,
    read_one (blakeImage out1), read_g (blakeImage out1), read_lit (blakeImage out1) 2,
    read_lit (blakeImage out1) 3, read_lit (blakeImage out1) 4, read_lit (blakeImage out1) 5,
    read_lit (blakeImage out1) 6, read_lit (blakeImage out1) 7, read_lit (blakeImage out1) 8,
    Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some]
  rfl

name: jumpSentinel_row1
statement: theorem jumpSentinel_row1 : step jumpSentinelProg ctlImage Regs.initial = some ⟨g, g⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_of_fetch_eq_some (r := Regs.initial) (fetch_one _)]
  show execute ctlImage ⟨1, 1⟩ (.jump (gpow 2) (gpow 14) (gpow 14)) = _
  simp only [execute, one_mul, read_lit ctlImage 2, read_lit ctlImage 14]
  decide +kernel

name: jumpSentinel_row2
statement:
theorem jumpSentinel_row2 :
    step jumpSentinelProg ctlImage ⟨g, g⟩ = some (Regs.final jumpSentinelProg)
proof:
:= by
  rw [step_of_fetch_eq_some (r := ⟨g, g⟩) (jumpSentinelProg.fetch_gpow 1)]
  show execute ctlImage ⟨g, g⟩ (.jump g (gpow 13) g) = some ⟨gpow 1, 1⟩
  have hgg : g * g = gpow 2 := (pow_two g).symm
  simp only [execute, hgg, g_mul_gpow, read_lit ctlImage 2, read_lit ctlImage 14]
  decide +kernel

name: ofWords_lowWord_highWord
statement: private theorem ofWords_lowWord_highWord (a : K) : ofWords (lowWord a) (highWord a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have := BitVec.extractLsb'_append_extractLsb'_eq_extractLsb' (x := a) (start₁ := 0) (len₁ := 32)
    (start₂ := 32) (len₂ := 32) rfl
  simpa [ofWords, lowWord, highWord] using this

name: wordsCell_cellWords
statement: theorem wordsCell_cellWords {x : E} (h : IsCanonical128 x) : wordsCell (cellWords x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : x.limb 2 = 0 := h
  apply E.ext; intro i
  rw [wordsCell, limb_ofLimbs]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [cellWords, ofWords_lowWord_highWord, h2]

name: run_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem run_zero (r : Regs) : run prog L 0 r = some r
proof: := rfl

name: run_succ
statement:
theorem run_succ (n : ℕ) (r : Regs) :
    run prog L (n + 1) r = if r.pc = prog.finalPc then none else step prog L r >>= run prog L n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: run_succ_of_ne
statement:
theorem run_succ_of_ne {r : Regs} (h : r.pc ≠ prog.finalPc) (n : ℕ) :
    run prog L (n + 1) r = step prog L r >>= run prog L n
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_succ, if_neg h]

name: run_succ_of_eq
statement:
theorem run_succ_of_eq {r : Regs} (h : r.pc = prog.finalPc) (n : ℕ) :
    run prog L (n + 1) r = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_succ, if_pos h]

name: run_add
statement:
theorem run_add (m n : ℕ) (r : Regs) :
    run prog L (m + n) r = run prog L m r >>= run prog L n
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [show m + 1 + n = m + n + 1 by omega, run_succ, run_succ]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · rw [bind_assoc]
      exact bind_congr fun r' ↦ ih r'

name: run_prefix
statement:
theorem run_prefix {m n : ℕ} {r r'' : Regs} (h : run prog L (m + n) r = some r'') :
    ∃ r', run prog L m r = some r' ∧ run prog L n r' = some r''
proof:
:= by
  rw [run_add] at h
  exact Option.bind_eq_some_iff.mp h

name: pc_ne_finalPc_of_run_succ
statement:
theorem pc_ne_finalPc_of_run_succ {n : ℕ} {r r' : Regs} (h : run prog L (n + 1) r = some r') :
    r.pc ≠ prog.finalPc
proof:
:=
  fun hpc ↦ by rw [run_succ_of_eq hpc] at h; exact Option.some_ne_none r' h.symm

name: run_intermediate
statement:
theorem run_intermediate {n : ℕ} {r r' : Regs} (h : run prog L n r = some r') {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m < n) : ∃ r₁, run prog L m r = some r₁ ∧ r₁.pc ≠ prog.finalPc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = m + (k + 1) := ⟨n - m - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨r₁, h₁, h₂⟩ := run_prefix h
  exact ⟨r₁, h₁, pc_ne_finalPc_of_run_succ h₂⟩

name: Trace.regs_length
statement:
theorem Trace.regs_length {prog : Program} {t : Trace prog} {r : Regs}
    (h : run prog t.image t.steps Regs.initial = some r) : t.regs.length = t.steps + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Trace.regs]
  refine (List.filterMap_length_eq_length.mpr ?_).trans List.length_range
  intro n hn
  rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (List.mem_range.mp hn) with hlt | rfl
  · obtain ⟨r₁, h₁, -⟩ := run_intermediate h hlt
    simp [h₁]
  · simp [h]

name: Program.logSize_lt
statement: private theorem Program.logSize_lt (prog : Program) : prog.logSize < 64
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt prog.logSize_le (by decide)

name: Program.fetch_gpow
statement:
theorem Program.fetch_gpow (prog : Program) (i : Fin (2 ^ prog.logSize)) :
    prog.fetch (gpow i) = some (prog.code i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Program.fetch, (gLog?_spec prog.logSize_lt).mpr rfl, Option.map_some]

name: Program.fetch_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem Program.fetch_eq_some_iff (prog : Program) {pc : K} {ins : Instr} :
    prog.fetch pc = some ins ↔ ∃ i : Fin (2 ^ prog.logSize), pc = gpow i ∧ prog.code i = ins
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Program.fetch, Option.map_eq_some_iff, gLog?_spec prog.logSize_lt]

name: Program.fetch_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem Program.fetch_eq_none_iff (prog : Program) {pc : K} :
    prog.fetch pc = none ↔ ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ prog.logSize), pc ≠ gpow i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Program.fetch, Option.map_eq_none_iff, gLog?_eq_none_iff]

name: Program.fetch_zero
statement: theorem Program.fetch_zero (prog : Program) : prog.fetch 0 = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [Program.fetch, gLog?_zero, Option.map_none]

name: step_eq_none_of_fetch_eq_none
statement:
theorem step_eq_none_of_fetch_eq_none {κ : ℕ} {prog : Program} {L : MemImage κ} {r : Regs}
    (h : prog.fetch r.pc = none) : step prog L r = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [step, h]; rfl

name: step_of_fetch_eq_some
statement:
theorem step_of_fetch_eq_some {κ : ℕ} {prog : Program} {L : MemImage κ} {r : Regs} {ins : Instr}
    (h : prog.fetch r.pc = some ins) : step prog L r = execute L r ins
proof:
:= by
  rw [step, h]; rfl

name: gLog
statement:
theorem gLog?_spec {κ : ℕ} (hκ : κ < 64) {a : K} {i : Fin (2 ^ κ)} :
    gLog? κ a = some i ↔ a = gpow i
proof:
:= by
  unfold gLog?
  split_ifs with h
  · have hc := Classical.choose_spec h
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain rfl := Option.some.inj hi
      exact hc
    · intro hi
      have hbound : 2 ^ κ ≤ 2 ^ 63 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
      have hj : ((Classical.choose h : Fin (2 ^ κ)) : ℕ) < 2 ^ 64 - 1 := by
        have := (Classical.choose h).isLt; omega
      have hi' : (i : ℕ) < 2 ^ 64 - 1 := by have := i.isLt; omega
      exact congrArg some (Fin.ext (gpow_injOn hj hi' (hc.symm.trans hi)))
  · exact ⟨fun hi ↦ (nomatch hi), fun hi ↦ absurd ⟨i, hi⟩ h⟩

name: gLog
statement:
theorem gLog?_eq_none_iff {κ : ℕ} {a : K} :
    gLog? κ a = none ↔ ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ κ), a ≠ gpow i
proof:
:= by
  unfold gLog?
  split_ifs with h
  · exact ⟨fun hn ↦ (nomatch hn), fun hn ↦ absurd h (not_exists.mpr hn)⟩
  · exact ⟨fun _ ↦ not_exists.mp h, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: gLog
statement: theorem gLog?_zero (κ : ℕ) : gLog? κ 0 = none
proof:
:=
  gLog?_eq_none_iff.mpr fun i h ↦ gpow_ne_zero i h.symm

name: gLog
statement:
theorem gLog?_gpow_eq_none {κ j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ^ κ ≤ j) (hj' : j < 2 ^ 64 - 1) :
    gLog? κ (gpow j) = none
proof:
:=
  gLog?_eq_none_iff.mpr fun i h ↦ by
    have hi : (i : ℕ) < 2 ^ 64 - 1 := by have := i.isLt; omega
    have := gpow_injOn hj' hi h
    have := i.isLt
    omega

name: MemImage.read_gpow
statement:
theorem MemImage.read_gpow {κ : ℕ} (hκ : κ < 64) (L : MemImage κ) (i : Fin (2 ^ κ)) :
    L.read (gpow i) = some (L i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MemImage.read, (gLog?_spec hκ).mpr rfl, Option.map_some]

name: MemImage.read_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem MemImage.read_eq_some_iff {κ : ℕ} (hκ : κ < 64) (L : MemImage κ) {a : K} {v : E} :
    L.read a = some v ↔ ∃ i : Fin (2 ^ κ), a = gpow i ∧ L i = v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MemImage.read, Option.map_eq_some_iff, gLog?_spec hκ]

name: MemImage.read_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem MemImage.read_eq_none_iff {κ : ℕ} (L : MemImage κ) {a : K} :
    L.read a = none ↔ ∀ i : Fin (2 ^ κ), a ≠ gpow i
proof:
:= by
  rw [MemImage.read, Option.map_eq_none_iff, gLog?_eq_none_iff]

name: MemImage.read_zero
statement: theorem MemImage.read_zero {κ : ℕ} (L : MemImage κ) : L.read 0 = none
proof:
:= by
  rw [MemImage.read, gLog?_zero, Option.map_none]

name: PublicInput.words_injective
statement:
theorem PublicInput.words_injective :
    Function.Injective fun p : PublicInput ↦ (p.word0, p.word1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p⟩ ⟨q⟩ h
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, PublicInput.word0, PublicInput.word1] at h
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : E ↦ z.limb 0) h.1
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : E ↦ z.limb 1) h.1
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : E ↦ z.limb 0) h.2
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : E ↦ z.limb 1) h.2

name: vecCons_apply
statement: private theorem vecCons_apply (om : Fin 4 → K) : ![om 0, om 1, om 2, om 3] = om
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: derefMode
statement:
theorem derefMode?_flags (m : DerefMode) :
    derefMode? (derefFlags m).1 (derefFlags m).2 = some m
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> simp [derefMode?, derefFlags]

name: derefMode
statement:
theorem derefMode?_eq_some_iff {fpc ffp : K} {m : DerefMode} :
    derefMode? fpc ffp = some m ↔ (fpc, ffp) = derefFlags m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold derefMode? at h
    split_ifs at h with h1 h2 h3 <;> cases h
    · exact Prod.ext h1.1 h1.2
    · exact Prod.ext h2.1 h2.2
    · exact Prod.ext h3.1 h3.2
  · intro h
    cases m <;> simp only [derefFlags, Prod.mk.injEq] at h <;> obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h <;>
      simp [derefMode?]

name: opcode
statement: theorem opcode?_code (o : Opcode) : opcode? o.code = some o
proof:
:= by
  cases o <;> simp [opcode?, Opcode.code_injective.eq_iff]

name: opcode
statement: theorem opcode?_eq_some_iff {a : K} {o : Opcode} : opcode? a = some o ↔ a = o.code
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold opcode? at h
    split_ifs at h <;> cases h <;> assumption
  · rintro rfl
    exact opcode?_code o

name: entry_getElem_zero
statement: theorem entry_getElem_zero (i : Instr) : (entry i)[0] = i.opcode.code
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> rfl

name: decode_entry
statement: theorem decode_entry (i : Instr) : decode (entry i) = some i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | blake2s om ocv oout omd =>
    have h := vecCons_apply om
    simp [decode, entry, opcode?_code, h]
  | _ => simp [decode, entry, opcode?_code, derefMode?_flags, ofLimbs_limb]

name: decode_eq_some_iff
statement: theorem decode_eq_some_iff {v : Vector K 8} {i : Instr} : decode v = some i ↔ v = entry i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold decode at h
    rcases hop : opcode? v[0] with _ | op
    · rw [hop] at h
      cases h
    · rw [hop] at h
      rw [opcode?_eq_some_iff] at hop
      cases op <;> dsimp only at h
      case deref =>
        rcases hm : derefMode? v[4] v[5] with _ | mode
        · rw [hm] at h
          cases h
        · rw [hm] at h
          dsimp only at h
          rw [derefMode?_eq_some_iff, Prod.mk.injEq] at hm
          split_ifs at h with hz
          cases h
          refine Vector.ext fun j hj ↦ ?_
          interval_cases j <;> simp [entry, hop, hm.1, hm.2, hz.1, hz.2]
      all_goals
        first
        | (split_ifs at h with hz
           cases h
           refine Vector.ext fun j hj ↦ ?_
           interval_cases j <;> simp [entry, hop, hz])
        | (cases h
           refine Vector.ext fun j hj ↦ ?_
           interval_cases j <;> simp [entry, hop])
  · rintro rfl
    exact decode_entry i

name: decode_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem decode_eq_none_iff {v : Vector K 8} : decode v = none ↔ ∀ i, v ≠ entry i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Option.eq_none_iff_forall_ne_some, ne_eq, decode_eq_some_iff]

name: entry_injective
statement: theorem entry_injective : Function.Injective entry
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have hi := decode_entry i
  rw [h, decode_entry] at hi
  exact (Option.some.inj hi).symm

name: encodeSlots_getElem
statement:
theorem encodeSlots_getElem (i : Instr) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < 16) :
    (encodeSlots i)[j] = if h : 3 ≤ j ∧ j < 11 then (entry i)[j - 3] else 0
proof:
:= by
  interval_cases j <;> simp [encodeSlots]

name: Opcode.code_injective
statement: theorem Opcode.code_injective : Function.Injective Opcode.code
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  cases a <;> cases b <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (by decide +kernel)

name: instFiniteFieldK_toField
statement: theorem instFiniteFieldK_toField : (instFiniteFieldK.toField : Field K) = BF64.instField
proof: := rfl

name: card_sub_one_factorization
statement:
theorem card_sub_one_factorization :
    (2 : ℕ) ^ 64 - 1 = 3 * 5 * 17 * 257 * 641 * 65537 * 6700417
proof: := by norm_num

name: g_ne_zero
statement: theorem g_ne_zero : g ≠ 0
proof: := by decide

name: g_pow_card_sub_one
statement: theorem g_pow_card_sub_one : g ^ (2 ^ 64 - 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one g g_ne_zero
  
  simp only [BF64.card_bf64] at h
  exact h

name: g_pow_div_three_ne_one
statement: theorem g_pow_div_three_ne_one : g ^ ((2 ^ 64 - 1) / 3) ≠ 1
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: g_pow_div_five_ne_one
statement: theorem g_pow_div_five_ne_one : g ^ ((2 ^ 64 - 1) / 5) ≠ 1
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: g_pow_div_seventeen_ne_one
statement: theorem g_pow_div_seventeen_ne_one : g ^ ((2 ^ 64 - 1) / 17) ≠ 1
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: g_pow_div_257_ne_one
statement: theorem g_pow_div_257_ne_one : g ^ ((2 ^ 64 - 1) / 257) ≠ 1
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: g_pow_div_641_ne_one
statement: theorem g_pow_div_641_ne_one : g ^ ((2 ^ 64 - 1) / 641) ≠ 1
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: g_pow_div_65537_ne_one
statement: theorem g_pow_div_65537_ne_one : g ^ ((2 ^ 64 - 1) / 65537) ≠ 1
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: g_pow_div_6700417_ne_one
proof: := by decide +kernel

name: orderOf_g
statement: theorem orderOf_g : orderOf g = 2 ^ 64 - 1
proof:
:= by
  refine orderOf_eq_of_pow_and_pow_div_prime (by norm_num) g_pow_card_sub_one
    fun p hp hdvd ↦ ?_
  rw [card_sub_one_factorization] at hdvd
  simp only [Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp, or_assoc] at hdvd
  rcases hdvd with h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
    rw [(Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (by norm_num)).mp h]
  exacts [g_pow_div_three_ne_one, g_pow_div_five_ne_one, g_pow_div_seventeen_ne_one,
    g_pow_div_257_ne_one, g_pow_div_641_ne_one, g_pow_div_65537_ne_one,
    g_pow_div_6700417_ne_one]

name: gpow_injOn
statement: theorem gpow_injOn : Set.InjOn gpow (Set.Iio (2 ^ 64 - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← orderOf_g]
  exact pow_injOn_Iio_orderOf

name: gpow_succ
statement: theorem gpow_succ (i : ℕ) : gpow (i + 1) = g * gpow i
proof: := pow_succ' g i

name: gpow_ne_zero
statement: theorem gpow_ne_zero (i : ℕ) : gpow i ≠ 0
proof: := pow_ne_zero i g_ne_zero

name: y_pow_three
statement: theorem y_pow_three : y ^ 3 = y + 1
proof: := BF64.ext3Gen_pow_three

name: E.ext
statement: theorem E.ext {x z : E} (h : ∀ i, x.limb i = z.limb i) : x = z
proof: := Ext.ext h

name: limb_ofLimbs
statement:
@[simp] theorem limb_ofLimbs (c0 c1 c2 : K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (E.ofLimbs c0 c1 c2).limb i = ![c0, c1, c2] i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: limb_ofK
statement:
@[simp] theorem limb_ofK (a : K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (ofK a).limb i = if (i : ℕ) = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:=
  Ext.coeff_ofBase (P := BF64.ext3Params) a i

name: ofK_injective
statement: theorem ofK_injective : Function.Injective ofK
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  simpa using congrArg (fun z : E ↦ z.limb 0) h

name: E.eq_sum_limbs
statement:
theorem E.eq_sum_limbs (x : E) :
    x = ofK (x.limb 0) + ofK (x.limb 1) * y + ofK (x.limb 2) * y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply Ext.toQuot_injective
  have hx : Ext.toQuot x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      algebraMap K (AdjoinRoot BF64.ext3Params.poly) (x.limb i) *
        Ext.rt BF64.ext3Params ^ (i : ℕ) := rfl
  rw [hx, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp [y]

name: ofLimbs_eq
statement:
theorem ofLimbs_eq (c0 c1 c2 : K) :
    E.ofLimbs c0 c1 c2 = ofK c0 + ofK c1 * y + ofK c2 * y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [E.eq_sum_limbs (E.ofLimbs c0 c1 c2)]
  simp

name: ofLimbs_limb
statement: theorem ofLimbs_limb (x : E) : E.ofLimbs (x.limb 0) (x.limb 1) (x.limb 2) = x
proof:
:=
  E.ext fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> simp

name: isInK_iff
statement: theorem isInK_iff (x : E) : IsInK x ↔ ∃ a, x = ofK a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨x.limb 0, E.ext fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> simp [h1, h2]⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
